#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin.ignore(); // ignore the remaining newline after reading n
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);

    std::string processed;
    int parentWordsCount = 0;
    size_t i = 0;

    while (i < line.length()) {
        if (line[i] == '(') {
            processed += '_';
            i++;
            std::string insideParens;
            while (i < line.length() && line[i] != ')') {
                insideParens += line[i];
                i++;
            }
            // Skip the closing parenthesis
            if (i < line.length() && line[i] == ')') {
                i++;
            }
            std::stringstream ss(insideParens);
            std::string word;
            while (std::getline(ss, word, '_')) {
                if (!word.empty()) {
                    parentWordsCount++;
                }
            }
        } else {
            processed += line[i];
            i++;
        }
    }

    std::stringstream ss(processed);
    std::string segment;
    int maxLen = 0;
    while (std::getline(ss, segment, '_')) {
        if (!segment.empty() && (int)segment.length() > maxLen) {
            maxLen = segment.length();
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxLen << " " << parentWordsCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
